items.criterion: Navigate to OpenStreetMap search results for 'British Museum, London' and open an object page
items.description: Agent uses OpenStreetMap (no sign-in) to search for the British Museum in London (starting from the provided search URL is acceptable) and attempts to open a specific matching object's page. Full credit if the object page is opened successfully OR if OpenStreetMap access is blocked by uncontrollable issues (CAPTCHA, outage, blocked scripts) and the agent clearly reports the blocker after reasonable attempt(s). Partial credit if the agent reaches search results but does not clearly open any object page and does not report a blocker.

items.criterion: Select the correct British Museum object (Great Russell Street, London)
items.description: Agent selects the exact British Museum on Great Russell Street in London (not a similarly named result) and provides enough evidence from the page/results to disambiguate (e.g., street name, nearby context, or the feature title matching the well-known museum). Full credit if the chosen object is clearly the correct British Museum. If OSM is inaccessible or the object page cannot be opened/confirmed due to uncontrollable issues, award full credit if the agent explains the ambiguity/blocker and demonstrates a reasonable attempt to pick the Great Russell Street result from available information. No credit if the agent reports details for a different entity when the correct one is available and accessible.

items.criterion: Report displayed OSM object type and ID
items.description: From the opened object page, report the displayed OSM object type (e.g., node/way/relation) and the object ID. Full credit if both are correct and explicitly stated. If the object page cannot be opened due to uncontrollable access issues, award full credit only if the agent explicitly states the type/ID are unavailable because the page could not be reached (do not infer). Partial credit if only one of type or ID is provided from the displayed page.

items.criterion: Report tag values: addr:street, addr:city, addr:postcode
items.description: Report the values as shown on the object page for addr:street, addr:city, and addr:postcode. Full credit if all three are correctly copied from the page; if any are not present on the page, the agent must explicitly report them as unavailable (not inferred). If the object page cannot be opened due to uncontrollable issues, award full credit if the agent reports these tags as unavailable due to inability to access the object page (and does not infer values). Partial credit if 1–2 are correctly copied and the rest are missing/incorrect/inferred.

items.criterion: Report tag values: tourism, museum, website
items.description: Report the values as shown on the object page for tourism, museum, and website. Full credit if all three are correctly copied from the page; if any are not present on the page, the agent must explicitly report them as unavailable (not inferred). If the object page cannot be opened due to uncontrollable issues, award full credit if the agent reports these tags as unavailable due to inability to access the object page (and does not infer values). Partial credit if 1–2 are correct and the rest are missing/incorrect/inferred.

items.criterion: Respect constraints: no sign-in/editing; stop after recording requested identifiers and tags
items.description: Agent does not sign into OpenStreetMap or attempt edits, and stops once the exact British Museum object and all requested displayed identifiers/tag values have been recorded (or clearly reports they are unavailable due to access blockers). Full credit if constraints are followed. Partial credit if there is minor extra unrelated browsing but no sign-in/editing happens. No credit if the agent signs in, attempts to edit, or continues unnecessary browsing after completion.
